stopConditions: frozen source revision cannot be read
assigned atom is absent from canon
owned report path conflicts with preserved work
failureClasses: path/input missing: rediscover exact path once, then return TRUE_BLOCKER with raw error
tool/dependency missing: use repository-native read tools once, then continue with explicit evidence limitation
auth/permission failure: perform all readable work, then TRUE_BLOCKER only if assigned atom cannot be assessed
transient external failure: not applicable; no network dependency
invalid input/schema: reread prompt + canon once, then stop on contradiction
integrity/hash mismatch: stop before source review & report observed revision
deterministic command failure: narrow to direct file reads or rg once
dirty/conflicting state: edit owned report only; stop if owned path is dirty
wrong producer/provenance: reject generated/build evidence & seek production consumer once
resource/capacity failure: complete assessed rows & preserve exact unresolved list
ambiguous requirement: retain UNKNOWN/PARTIAL with explicit ambiguity; do not invent
unsafe/out-of-scope action: skip action & continue read-only assessment
unknown failure: preserve report state, raw error & exact resume point
